heroSubheading: Sales, servicing and advice for your outdoor power needs
aboutHtml:
We've run STIHL SHOP East Tamaki since 2004, and we know what the local community needs. We stock STIHL, Masport, Honda Power Equipment, Walker, Hustler and Hansa. Whether you're a homeowner keeping up the lawn, a contractor on the job, or running a large operation, we have the equipment and the expertise to match.

Our fully equipped workshop and trained technicians service all brands we stock. Everything is fully assembled and ready to use when you take it home. We offer home delivery and Click and Collect, and our team has the practical experience to give you sound advice on what will work best for you.

We're locals ourselves, and we support our community through schools, sports clubs and the Beachlands Fire Brigade. Come in and see the difference a proper dealer makes.
